title: Replication package for: From Obligation to Enforcement Point: A Deficit-Driven Method for Placing AI Governance Controls in Enterprise Architectures
description: Evidence and reproduction steps for the paper's evaluation: the development, held-out and untouched corpora, the sealed protocols and prediction records, the documented-architecture retrodiction cases, the adversary-sensitivity and cause-ablation data, the counting rules (CLAIMS.md), and verify.py, which recomputes the reported counts from the data files and checks the manuscript against them (run: python3 verify.py; standard library only).
